name: spsm
description: St. Philopater Mercurius & St. Mina — website, PWA, and shared Firebase backend

scripts.//dev: The everyday one: the website at http://localhost:3000. Builds @spsm/shared first because the app imports its compiled dist/, not its TypeScript source.
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @spsm/shared && npm run dev --workspace @spsm/website
scripts.//dev:https: The same as `dev`, over HTTPS. Use this to work on checkout: browsers only offer a saved card on a secure origin. Pair it with `dev:backend` in another terminal so the payment POST has a Function to reach.
scripts.dev:https: npm run build --workspace @spsm/shared && npm run dev:https --workspace @spsm/website
scripts.//dev:backend: Emulator suite, for rules and Cloud Functions work. Unrelated to `dev` — the website talks to the real Firestore, not the emulator.
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build --workspace @spsm/shared && npm run build --workspace @spsm/functions && npm run emulators
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @spsm/shared && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.//verify:scopes: Checks every credential in .env against the live services, and that the two external service accounts are scoped the way docs/integrations.md claims.
scripts.//bulletin: Prints this week's bulletin exactly as the site build reads it. First stop when the homepage bulletin section is missing.
scripts.//config: Shows config/integrations; --write creates it from the committed defaults.
scripts.//content: Pushes content/*.md into the Firestore `content` collection. Dry run by default; -- --write applies.
scripts.//catalog: Mirror the Square bookstore catalog into Firestore products.
scripts.//archive: Refresh the committed snapshot of past livestreams.
scripts.//assets: Rebuilds the web-ready images in public/ and app/ from the originals in assets/. Run after adding a photo; --check verifies the committed outputs exist.
scripts.//dev:local: The whole site against the emulators, with sample data and sign-in-able accounts. The only way to work on /admin or /servants, since both need a role and the real project only grants one to the parish directory.
scripts.dev:local: npm run build --workspace @spsm/shared && node scripts/seed-emulator.mjs && NEXT_PUBLIC_USE_EMULATORS=1 npm run dev --workspace @spsm/website
scripts.//seed:emulator: Re-fills the emulators without restarting the dev server.
scripts.//backfill:screens: Adds the screenAdmin map to member documents written before per-screen permissions existed. Dry run by default; -- --write applies. Grants nothing — every screen is written false.
scripts.//grant-admin: Bootstraps the first admin by email. setMemberRole needs an admin to call it, and at the start nobody is one.
scripts.//test: Pure functions from @spsm/shared. No emulator, no network, no credentials — runs in about a second, so there is no excuse not to.
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @spsm/shared && vitest run --project unit
scripts.//test:rules: firestore.rules evaluated against a real emulator. This is the one that would have caught decision #10 on day one; `rules:check` only compiles. Needs a JDK.
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-spsm "vitest run --project rules"
